note: Shop sizes from the parameters. nominal_full_bottle_kg is a design input for the payload line, not a measured load rating.

pieces.name: side-panel
pieces.notes: Full sides. Right panel: cable groove, inlet and outlet sensor holes, ESP32 pattern. Left panel: tile pockets.

pieces.name: deck
pieces.notes: One sloped lane floor. Install at the module slope.

pieces.name: front-apron
pieces.notes: Closes the front below the outlet.

pieces.name: top-strip
pieces.notes: Front and rear strips with hooked stack pockets.

pieces.name: stack-foot
pieces.notes: Locating foot with a forward toe. Glue or screw under the base.

pieces.name: post
pieces.notes: Rear corners. 20×20 mm outer envelope only; T-slot is not cut here.

pieces.name: rail
pieces.notes: Top front and top rear rails. 20×20 mm outer envelope only.

pieces.name: lane-guide
pieces.notes: Printed side guide. Three 3.4 mm holes in the flange.

pieces.name: outlet-gate
pieces.notes: Printed lift gate with a finger notch. One per lane.

pieces.name: tile-pin
pieces.notes: Press into the right side. The left side of the next module has the pocket.

hardware.name: M3x12 SHCS
hardware.notes: Lane guides into the decks. Clearance drill 3.4 mm (ISO 273 medium).

hardware.name: M3x10 SHCS
hardware.notes: Two screws at each lane inlet, two at each lane outlet, four on the ESP32 pattern.

hardware.name: M3 hex nut
hardware.notes: Nuts for the sensor and ESP32 screws.
